title: catastophic
content: Catastrophic\*\*\*\* Last night I was in Mall world and it was being attacked by aliens with high technology, they had these drones that were going around seeking out heat sources to find hidden people in mall world. I was with a small group of people, and we were running and hiding anywhere we could to get away from the chaos. From the sky were giant fireballs being spewed at us and blowing up everything around us. We went underground through a subway system and hid there until the fireballs stopped. This is not the first time I have had this dream, probably like the 4th or 5th time.
